meta.title: Kampung Sumber Alam · Hot spring stay in Garut, West Java, Indonesia
meta.desc: Stay in a thatched wooden house built over a fish pond in Cipanas, Garut, West Java. Natural hot spring water from Mount Guntur flows straight into the bath in your room.
pembuka.lead: You'll stay in a wooden house at Kampung Sumber Alam in Cipanas, Garut, West Java. The soaking tub is in your own bathroom, so you can soak early in the morning or at night before bed.
sambut.label: Wilujeng Sumping
sambut.judul: Stay in a wooden house over a fish pond
sambut.p1: Wilujeng sumping means "welcome" in Sundanese, the language we speak here in West Java. Kampung Sumber Alam is in Cipanas, Garut. The wooden houses are roofed with ijuk, a palm-fibre thatch, and they stand over ponds of fish and water lilies. In Sundanese, a pond like this is called a balong.
sambut.p2: The hot water here is natural. It comes from Mount Guntur, the volcano you can see behind the houses. You can soak in your own room, in a private soaking room, or in the swimming pool.
berendam.judul: There are four places to soak
berendam.pengantar: The closest one is your own bathroom.
berendam.1.nama: Hot spring bath in your room
berendam.1.isi: In every bungalow, the bathtub has a separate tap for hot spring water from Mount Guntur. Just turn it on and soak.
berendam.2.isi: Kamar Rendam is a private soaking room. A 25-minute soak costs IDR 50,000 and comes with bandrek, a hot ginger drink, or bajigur, a warm drink of coconut milk and palm sugar.
berendam.3.isi: This is our public swimming pool, where you swim in hot spring water. It's in the middle of the Kampung Sumber Alam grounds.
berendam.4.isi: Stay at Villa Sibentang and you can soak in natural hot spring water in the villa's own private pool.
kata.p: Each word in this name stands for something you'll find for yourself at Kampung Sumber Alam. Swipe to read →
menginap.judul: Whether there are two of you or 18, we have a room that fits
menginap.p: We have 14 room types. A Bungalow suits two guests, and Babakan Siluhur sleeps 18. From your room you can walk everywhere, along footpaths that pass the fish ponds (balong) and the open-sided huts (saung).

cara.judul: Is it just the two of you, your family, or your team?
cara.1.label: For two · weekday
cara.1.nama: A stay for two, Sunday to Friday
cara.1.isi: The two of you share a room in the main area, Sunday to Friday. A soak in Kamar Rendam, the private soaking room, is included.
cara.2.label: Family · weekend
cara.2.nama: A family stay with Saturday check-in
cara.2.isi: Check in on Saturday and book through WhatsApp. Dinner, breakfast, live music, a fishing package, swimming pool tickets, and Kamar Rendam are all included.
cara.2.harga: From IDR 1,989,000 per room per night (Kawung, 2 adults)
cara.3.label: Team · weekday
cara.3.isi: Your team stays one night in Bungalow rooms and meets in a hall that holds up to 350 people. The package includes three buffet meals, two coffee breaks, the swimming pool, and Kamar Rendam.
cara.3.harga: IDR 1,433,000 per person, Twin Share, weekday
cara.catatan: We'll confirm these rates when you book.
seharian.judul: Here is what you do in a day at Kampung Sumber Alam
seharian.p: You eat at Restoran Tunjung Balebat or Restoran Ligar Wangi. Order Nasi Liwet (Sundanese rice cooked with herbs), Nasi Lulun Botram (a shared meal on banana leaf) or Nasi Tutug Oncom (rice mixed with fermented soybean cake), then a warm Secang. Your children join Melukis Caping, where they paint a farmer's hat, Melukis Layangan, where they paint a kite, or Jaipong, a Sundanese dance. While they are busy, you can go to Pitaloka Spa or fish at our fishing pond.

seharian.foto2: You hear Kacapi Suling, the Sundanese zither and bamboo flute, played live
seharian.foto3: The house roofs are made of ijuk, a palm-fibre thatch
seharian.foto4: In the balong, our fish pond, fish swim among the water lilies
lokasi.label: Near the foot of Mount Guntur
lokasi.judul: We are in Cipanas, Garut, West Java
lokasi.p1: The hot spring water you soak in comes from Mount Guntur. The foot of the mountain is about 15 minutes from Kampung Sumber Alam.
lokasi.p2: Our address is Jl. Raya Cipanas No. 122, Tarogong Kaler, Garut, West Java, Indonesia. If you are not sure of the way, call us on (0262) 238000.
